title.narrative: Emergency WASH and Cash Distribution, Nobili

description.narrative: The project focuses on immediate relief with two main pillars: WASH and Multipurpose Cash Transfer. It includes providing drinking water, repairing water sources, and installing emergency sanitation facilities. Additionally, it entails giving a one-time cash distribution to registered IDP households to address urgent needs for water, sanitation, and purchasing power.

The project targets IDPs which are living with host families or in public spaces, such as schools, churches and market places.The total number of direct beneficiaries:6300 Households * 6 (average HH size) = 37.800 beneficiaries.The total number of people benefitting from the different layers of the emergency water supply activities will be clearer.
